# Asendify Realty

> Asendify Realty is a Pune real estate brokerage that lists flats for rent and for sale in three localities only: Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar and Viman Nagar. It is part of Asendify (asendify.co). Enquiries and site visits are arranged on WhatsApp: +91 90960 82894.

## How it works
- Browse listings by locality, type (rent or buy), BHK and budget, then message on WhatsApp from any listing.
- Asendify Realty checks requirements against available inventory and arranges site visits.
- Brokerage is due only once the deal is confirmed.

## Brokerage (fees)
- Rentals: 3 months' rent, charged to both the landlord and the tenant.
- Sales/purchases: 2% of the sale value, charged to both the buyer and the seller.

## Pages
- [Home](https://realty.asendify.co/): Overview, how brokerage works and featured listings.
- [All listings](https://realty.asendify.co/listings.html): Every flat for rent or sale, filterable by locality, BHK and budget. [Rent](https://realty.asendify.co/listings.html?type=rent) · [Buy](https://realty.asendify.co/listings.html?type=buy)
- [Koregaon Park](https://realty.asendify.co/koregaon-park.html): Flats for rent and sale in Koregaon Park, near North Main Road and Osho Garden.
- [Kalyani Nagar](https://realty.asendify.co/kalyani-nagar.html): Flats for rent and sale in Kalyani Nagar, near the airport and IT parks.
- [Viman Nagar](https://realty.asendify.co/viman-nagar.html): Flats and studios for rent and sale in Viman Nagar, near EON IT Park and Phoenix Marketcity.
- Property pages: https://realty.asendify.co/property.html?id=<listing id> (each listing shows price, size, furnishing, amenities and brokerage).
